text: You can schedule appointments by calling the main scheduling line (858) 534-3300 or by calling the provider's group directly. Many student health appointments can also be self-scheduled online in MyStudentChart : Log in to MyStudentChart > Click on Menu > Schedule an Appointment > Choose the type of visit you wish to schedule. Please plan to arrive 15 minutes before your scheduled appointment. Our policy allows us to accommodate a late arrival if you check-in within 5 minutes of your scheduled appointment time. If you are unable to attend your scheduled appointment, please cancel with at least 4 hours’ notice to avoid a $20 no-show fee. For each appointment, please anticipate being in the clinic for at least 1 hour to allow for check in, the visit with the provider, completion of any labs, x-rays, or additional testing, and obtaining pharmacy items if needed. Schedule a telehealth appointment via MyStudentChart or call (858) 534-3300. There is no cost for telehealth visits for students with UC SHIP or RAFT. Tips and Tricks for Students Coming to SHS Prior to Your Appointment Please complete your eCheck-In through MyStudentChart and sign all forms and fill out all assigned questionnaires. Download the MyChart app on your phone to make this process, as well as scheduling and messaging your provider much easier. NOTE: You are not “arrived” at your appointment until you enter your PID number on the tablets at SHS or check in with the group receptionist in person. The eCheck-In is for preliminary questions only. Hours and Location See updated hours and location information . You can find the Student Health Services building, and get walking or driving directions using the UC San Diego Interactive Campus Map . Calling Student Health Our main line is (858) 534-3300 . You will hear a recorded menu of options to help direct your call. Please note, if we are receiving a high volume of calls you may be placed on a brief hold or asked to leave a message.
